title: Planting 10,000 Mangrove Seedlings, PT Pelni Works to Restore Demak's Coast Through Planting the Future
excerpt: PT PELNI together with Relawan Nusantara planted 10,000 mangrove seedlings in Timbulsloko, Demak, as an effort to restore the ecosystem and protect the coast.
seoTitle: PT Pelni Plants 10,000 Mangroves in Demak - Relawan Nusantara
seoDescription: PT PELNI together with Relawan Nusantara planted 10,000 mangrove seedlings in Timbulsloko, Demak, as an effort to restore the ecosystem and protect the coast.
html:
Efforts to protect coastal areas from the threat of abrasion and the impacts of climate change continue through collaboration among various parties. PT Pelayaran Nasional Indonesia (PELNI) together with Relawan Nusantara held an action to plant 10,000 mangrove seedlings in Timbulsloko Village, Sayung District, Demak Regency, Central Java, through a movement titled Planting the Future.

This activity is part of the 2026 Social and Environmental Responsibility (Tanggung Jawab Sosial dan Lingkungan, TJSL) program of PT PELNI (Persero), supported by Danantara Indonesia and Badan Otorita Pengelola Pantai Utara Jawa (the North Coast of Java Management Authority). The action is also a follow-up to the Coastal Area Protection Demonstration Plotting program based on Nature-based Solutions (NbS), an approach that harnesses and restores nature as a solution to environmental challenges.

Timbulsloko Village, particularly the RT 05 / RW 10 area (neighborhood units), was chosen because it is one of the coastal areas facing serious environmental pressure from abrasion and sea level rise. These conditions have changed the coastal landscape and increased the challenges for the communities living around it.

Planting Mangroves to Restore the Coastal Ecosystem

Through the Planting the Future movement, the planting of 10,000 mangrove seedlings is a concrete step to support the recovery of Demak's coastal ecosystem. The species planted in this program is Rhizophora Mucronata (Bakau Hitam/Bakau Kurap), which is known for its strong resilience and sturdy root system that holds back coastal erosion.

Mangroves play an important role in maintaining the stability of coastal areas, reducing wave energy under certain conditions, and providing habitat for many kinds of biota. Besides serving as a natural barrier, mangrove ecosystems also play a role in storing carbon and supporting biodiversity. For that reason, mangrove restoration is one of the relevant approaches to strengthening the resilience of the coastal environment against various ecological pressures.

However, the success of planting is not determined only by the number of seedlings planted. Selecting a suitable location and mangrove species, the hydrological conditions, and the maintenance and monitoring of seedling growth are all important so that the ecological benefits can be realized over the long term.

Collaboration for a More Resilient Coastal Future

The collaboration of PT PELNI, Relawan Nusantara, Danantara Indonesia, and Badan Otorita Pengelola Pantai Utara Jawa through this program shows the importance of involving various parties in preserving the environment. The challenges facing coastal areas require sustained effort, from ecosystem restoration to strengthening the role of communities in looking after the environment where they live.

The Nature-based Solutions approach places nature as an important part of efforts to face climate change and disaster risk. Through the planting and restoration of mangroves, coastal areas are expected to gain better ecological carrying capacity while opening opportunities for sustaining the lives of surrounding communities.

The Planting the Future movement is part of a shared effort to care for Demak's coast. More than just planting seedlings, this activity carries hope for ecosystem recovery and a more sustainable future for the coastal area. We too can contribute directly to preserving Indonesia's nature through real action in the movement 1 Juta Pohon untuk Hutan Indonesia (1 Million Trees for Indonesia's Forests).

With collaboration and sustained care, today's step is expected to bring benefits for the environment and for generations to come.

Luaskan Manfaat
